versions.name: Hiking
versions.description: Condition yourself for distance, plan routes and trail lunches, then walk four ten-mile hikes and one twenty-mile hike, writing up the weather, the route, and what you saw each time.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
